args.prompt: One continuous cinematic architectural take. The camera stays out in the open floor space beside the bed and arcs smoothly to the left, keeping a clear unobstructed view of the room the whole time, never passing close behind curtains, wall panels or columns. It rotates slowly until the black cylindrical wood stove standing beside the tall black-framed windows is framed in a flattering three-quarter view with the forest windows and part of the bedroom still visible. The firebox is completely dark and unlit when the stove first comes into view. Only after the stove is clearly framed does a single small flame appear on the logs inside the closed firebox, then grow steadily into a warm wood fire behind the glass door, with soft amber reflections building on the black stove body and the stone floor. The flames stay entirely inside the stove. Slow stabilized gimbal movement, gentle ease-in and ease-out, natural parallax, level horizon, no foreground obstruction. Daylight and the rest of the room's lighting stay constant. The stove keeps its exact shape, glass door, flue pipe and position. The ceiling-mounted television stays folded up flat against the ceiling. No smoke in the room, no sparks, no fire outside the stove, no people, no text.
